# netbox_notification (Resource)

A notification tells a user about an event of an object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_notification" "example" {
  object_type = "dcim.site"
  object_id   = netbox_site.example.id
  user_id     = netbox_user.example.id
  event_type  = "object_updated"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_type` (String) The kind of event. One of [object_created, object_updated, object_deleted, job_started, job_completed, job_failed, job_errored].
- `object_id` (Number) The ID of the object the notification is about.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the object the notification is about, for example `dcim.site`.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user who gets the notification.

### Optional

- `read` (String) When the user read the notification, as a timestamp. Not set while it is unread.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_notification.example 1
```
